description: A character standing with both arms at sides, idly nodding/bobbing, 3s loop at 30fps (90 frames), 512x512. Calmer/more neutral than wave-character - good for reflective or explanatory beats rather than greetings.
notes: Same param/color convention as wave-character.config.json. Also carries the same mouth-closed/mouth-round/mouth-wide/mouth-mid shapes at the same coordinates, so build_short.py's lip sync works on it identically.
